This old dental clinic has been a fixture in Saphan Khwai since we were kids, and even now as adults, we still use the doctor's services. The atmosphere is traditional; you'll recognize the fish tank as soon as you enter.

We usually call to make an appointment in advance. Sometimes walk-ins have to wait in line.

If you're looking for a quality dentist, I highly recommend this place.
